title: required before proceed
name: Required before proceed
rule: Make people understand they must provide required data before they can proceed (for example enable Next only after required fields are filled).
pass_when: User can tell required data blocks proceed (disabled Next/Submit until required filled, or equivalent explicit gate).
fail_when: User can proceed with required fields empty and only learns on a later error, with no prior indication they must provide the data.
overview: Make required data an explicit gate before Next or Submit proceeds.
apply_when: Multi-step or submit flows that need required fields filled first.
not_when: Optional-only steps where empty fields may still proceed.
agent_hint: Gate Next/Submit until required fields are filled, or show an explicit block.
description: People must understand they have to provide required data before they can proceed — for example enabling Next only after required fields are filled. Pass when the user can tell required data blocks proceed via a disabled control or equivalent explicit gate; fail when they can advance with required fields empty and only learn on a later error with no prior indication. The gate must be visible before the failure, not only after.
